title: The control: a divergence taken over with no guidance does deliver a side effect twice
description: The app is the proving suite's FIXTURE APP: a fake harness that performs the goal's actions on the fake machine and reports each one as the cockpit does, through the same session writer a delegated app session is recorded through. It is not a provider and plays no cassette; every session it runs counts as one model reach, because an app session is the intelligence a learned procedure exists to stop paying for. The durability scenario's lifecycle and injection, held to its BASELINE arm: no ladder, no replay, no guidance. There the app meets the injected failure itself and the bare loop starts the goal again from its first action -- so the notice it already delivered is delivered twice, and the fake machine must count it. A counter that read zero here would make the durability scenario's zero mean nothing.
